surfaces.native: Original Clipboard Dialog with native multiline private field, notes and Read this Mac/Send to Mac/Get from Mac/Copy to this Mac/Close clipboard row Stack in body, not footer.
surfaces.states: Connecting actions can expose an enabled Clipboard button, but handler refuses until connected; empty/cached text; incoming text; pending/failure/missing-browser-API branches; view-only send refusal; unsupported non-ARD request; cap rejection; close/reopen; disconnect; late asynchronous read/write feedback guard.
surfaces.boundary: Read this Mac invokes viewer navigator.clipboard.readText; Copy to this Mac invokes writeText. Send to Mac invokes RFB clipboardPasteFrom; Get from Mac invokes ARD requestRemoteClipboard. View-only blocks sending text but does not block reading/requesting/copying. All are effects, never passive layout actions with real dependencies.

No memory wiping/RDF export/GC or live auth lifecycle acceptance follows from source.

proposedNoEffectSeam.fakeContract: Minimal fake with exact constructor URL/options checks, known event names/types, in-memory viewOnly/ARD properties, inert mode-byte recorder, focus/disconnect and strict refusal/counting of unexpected methods. proposedNoEffectSeam.globalGuards: Same-origin task-source routing, block /v1 endpoints and all actual WebSockets, deny real noVNC/ARD imports, no real navigator clipboard reference, no server/mesh/native operation or remote input. Unknown operations/args/effects fail collection. Fake observation is not real authentication, permission or connection evidence.
proposedNoEffectSeam.proposedGrouping: If later allocated: two sequential browser cohorts with two geometries each; A desktop/tall phone emphasizes local configuration/auth/lazy lifecycle, B short phone/enlarged text emphasizes viewport and clipboard controls. Dense state variants run on first geometry per group; both geometries sample core controls/own paint/keyboard/scroll. Exact roster/window must be allocated before any execution.
proposedNoEffectSeam.futureEvidence: Full names/static labels and own control/caption/value allocations versus actual ancestor clips; actual native keyboard/focus, modal/footer and scrollbar reach, first/middle/final long explanatory/multiline ranges rather than End-only. Separate native glyph/value observations. Fresh task-owned contexts, original read/mock counters and awaited original context/browser/server closes. Private dummy values, bootstrap/session handles and rasters remain outside Git. No RDF/memory wipe/OS reap or full live Screen Sharing claim.
